# platform-orchestrator_resource_type_versions (Data Source)

Lists retained Resource Type interface history, including immutable UUIDs, declarations and recorded publication actors/reasons.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_resource_type_versions" "storage" {
  resource_type_id = "storage"
}

output "storage_interface_history" {
  value = jsondecode(data.platform-orchestrator_resource_type_versions.storage.versions_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `versions_json` (String) Complete interface history in ascending version order as a JSON array.
